facts.material: bi-metal (high speed steel teeth on steel body) saws; mandrels and pilot drills of steel; carry case
facts.function: cutting holes in materials with hole saws held by mandrels with pilot drills
facts.form: retail kit of multiple hole saws, mandrels with pilot drills and a carry case

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8202 saw blades; 8207 interchangeable tools; 8206 sets of tools of 8202 to 8205

GRI 3(b): kit put up for retail sale; the hole saws give essential character (mandrels are parts of hole saws, case is a container under GRI 5); the kit is not an 8206 set because only one component type is within 8202 to 8205 (pilot drills are 8207)
GRI 6: 8202.99 other saw blades, including parts

rejected_alternatives.reason: set requires tools of at least two of headings 8202 to 8205; drills are heading 8207
hole saws are saw blades of 8202, saw blades are not other interchangeable tools
pilot drills are secondary to the saws for essential character

classification.rationale: No ruling on a hole saw kit was found that matched; N010859 (drill accessory kits, 8207.90.60) was seen but concerns bits and not hole saws, so it is not cited. Classification rests on the heading text and GRI 3(b).
